cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(iot-foundry-linux-endpoint C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Build options
option(PLDM_SUPPORT "Enable PLDM support" ON)

# Compiler flags
add_compile_options(-g -Og -Wall)
add_compile_definitions(MCTP_POSIX_UNIT_TEST)
add_compile_definitions(MCTP_HAVE_FILEIO)
# Define libpldm ABI macros (normally generated by meson build)
add_compile_definitions(LIBPLDM_ABI_STABLE=)
add_compile_definitions(LIBPLDM_ABI_TESTING=)
add_compile_definitions(LIBPLDM_ABI_DEPRECATED=)
add_compile_definitions(LIBPLDM_ABI_DEPRECATED_UNSAFE=)

# Include directories
include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libmctp
)

# libmctp source files (from submodule)
set(LIBMCTP_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libmctp/core.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libmctp/serial.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libmctp/alloc.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libmctp/log.c
)

# libpldm source files (from submodule)
set(LIBPLDM_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src/utils.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src/edac.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src/control.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src/dsp/base.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src/dsp/platform.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src/dsp/fru.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src/dsp/pdr.c
)

# Platform-specific sources
set(PLATFORM_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/main.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/platform.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/mctp_control.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/process_pldm.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/build_timestamp.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/fru.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/platform_effecter.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/platform_event.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/platform_log.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/platform_numsense.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/platform_pdr.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/platform_statesense.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/pdrs/config.c
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/pdrs/pdr_utils.c
)

# Create the endpoint executable
add_executable(endpoint
    ${PLATFORM_SOURCES}
    ${LIBMCTP_SOURCES}
    ${LIBPLDM_SOURCES}
)

# Link pthread library
target_link_libraries(endpoint pthread)

# Add PLDM support if enabled
if(PLDM_SUPPORT)
    target_compile_definitions(endpoint PRIVATE PLDM_SUPPORT)
    # Add libpldm include directory when needed
    target_include_directories(endpoint PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/include
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/subprojects/libpldm/src
    )
endif()

# Installation rules
install(TARGETS endpoint DESTINATION bin)
